description: This file implements a server for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) used in the Playwright project. It manages backend creation, server setup, request handling, and heartbeat functionality for MCP communication.

classes.name: BackendManager
classes.description: Manages creation and disposal of server backends.

classes.name: ServerBackendFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating server backend instances.

methods.name: createBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new backend instance.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a backend server via transport.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates an MCP server with request handlers.

methods.name: initializeServer
methods.description: Initializes server with client info and starts heartbeat if enabled.

methods.name: startHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts periodic ping to keep connection alive or close on failure.

methods.name: addServerListener
methods.description: Adds event listeners to server events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts MCP server or connects via stdio if no port specified.

methods.name: firstRootPath
methods.description: Returns the first root path from a list of roots.

methods.name: allRootPaths
methods.description: Returns all root paths from a list of roots.

methods.name: mergeTextParts
methods.description: Merges consecutive text parts in a CallToolResult.
